$comment: This file is auto-generated and is for apps only. Bundles SHOULD NOT rely on its content.

mistral_api_key.description: Empty: a scripted client answers, with no network.

tickets_token.description: The token of the forge a project names in its tickets setting. The installation's, never a project file's.

system_prompt.default: You are a concise assistant. Use the tools when they answer better than you do.

human_timeout_seconds.description: Deadline of every wait on a human: approval as well as question.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Silence after which the conversation ends.

max_tool_calls.description: Tool-calling rounds a turn may make. Past them, the turn ends on the model saying where it stands, with no tool it may call; the next message goes on. A TDD cycle with its review takes a dozen.

max_delegation_depth.description: How deep a chain of sub-agents may go. At that depth `delegate` is not offered at all, so the chain stops. 0 forbids delegating; without a bound an anonymous delegation could delegate for ever, each level costing a model call.

token_budget.description: What one run may spend in model tokens before it stops taking turns. 0: no ceiling — the spend is counted either way, and counting is the part that cannot be done afterwards.

instructions_file.description: Instructions of the installation, appended to the system prompt of every conversation, whatever the project. The project's own come from its .agentic/config.* (AGENTS.md by default). Missing: ignored; null: none.

when.description: argument → pattern its value must follow

modes.description: the modes where the rule holds; empty: all of them

unless.description: argument → patterns that set the rule aside

unless_roles.description: roles that set the rule aside — "refused, except to finance". Negative and not positive because deny wins: "refuse to everyone but X" cannot be written as two rules.

tool_rules.description: The decision hooks: for a tool (fnmatch pattern) and arguments, allow, ask or deny. deny > ask > allow; with no rule, the mode.

hidden.description: Project paths masked inside the sandbox (glob patterns): secrets, the agent journal.

worktrees.description: One git worktree per conversation (<workspace>/.worktrees/agentic-<id>, branch agentic/agentic-<id>, cut from HEAD): the agent writes there, not in the project. Off: it writes in the project.

shared.description: Ignored directories a worktree borrows read-only from the project (glob patterns): the installed dependencies.

auto_allow.description: The commands that pass without approval in auto mode (fnmatch patterns on the whole line); the others ask. Outside auto, the mode and tool_rules decide.

command.description: One command, or a list run in turn. Split like a terminal line, no shell; {report} is replaced by the report path; without it, the command prints its report (e.g. "vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --error-format=junit --no-progress").

cwd.description: Directory to run in, relative to the workspace root.

filter_option.description: The option that takes the model's filter, e.g. "--filter"; null: the layer runs whole.

description.description: What the model reads about the layer.

tests.description: Where the tests of this layer live, and how they are named — the agent places its new tests by it.

review.description: The layers to run once this one is green: those a change here can break, and the static ones.

checks.description: The layers of the run_checks tool — static, unit, functional, integration, e2e… —: a command that writes a JUnit report to {report}, run in the sandbox. None: no run_checks.

sandbox.description: The run_command, read_file and edit_file tools, run inside a bubblewrap sandbox: the workspace writable, no network and nothing else from the disk.

description.description: What it is for — the model reads this to choose.

prompt.description: Its instructions; empty takes the default system prompt.

model.description: Its model; null takes the caller's.

ceiling.description: The most it may ever do; the strictest of this and the parent wins.

tools.description: Patterns (fnmatch) of the tools it may use; empty = none.

roles.description: What it may still claim of its caller's identity. An intersection, never a grant: a role the caller does not hold stays out. Empty = it claims nothing.

agents.description: The sub-agents `delegate` may hand a mission to. A profile narrows what its sub-agent may do; it never grants more than the parent already has.

command.description: Command of a server spawned over stdio; exclusive with url.

url.description: Endpoint of a remote server; exclusive with command.

effects.description: Tool name pattern (fnmatch) → read, write or external. Authoritative over what the server says about itself.

trust_annotations.description: Believe the server's own hints (readOnlyHint…). Off by default: a tool that destroys can call itself read-only, and the guard is what protects from that.

mcp.description: MCP servers whose tools are offered to the agent, discovered when a conversation starts and frozen in its payload.

watch_subjects.description: The vocabulary of the watches: subject → what the model reads of it.

prefix_seed.description: Used to namespace cache keys when using several apps with the same shared backend.

app.description: App related cache pools configuration. Cannot be combined with "default_provider".

default_provider.description: DSN of the backend to use for "cache.app"; the adapter is deduced from it. Replaces "app", which cannot be set alongside it.

adapters.description: One or more adapters to chain for creating the pool, defaults to "cache.app".

examples: "300" for 5 minutes expressed in seconds, "PT5M" for five minutes expressed as ISO 8601 time interval, or "5 minutes" as a date expression

provider.description: Overwrite the setting from the default provider for this adapter.

examples: "messenger.default_bus" to send early expiration events to the default Messenger bus.

marshaller.description: The marshaller service to use for this pool.

connection.description: Service id of the Doctrine\DBAL\Connection to use

auto_setup.description: Create the missing tables on the first write. Set it to false as soon as doctrine/migrations holds the schema: otherwise the two mechanisms write one behind the other.

lock_factory.description: Service id of the Symfony\Component\Lock\LockFactory that serialises the resumes of one execution

dbal.description: DBAL backend: durable execution on a single SQL database, with no orchestration cluster (DUR030).

dsn.description: A temporal://… DSN (for instance %env(DURABLE_DSN)%). When set, it turns on the native Temporal backend (gRPC); requires ext-grpc. No SQL/PDO.

journal.description: false: the cluster is reachable, but the journal stays the one in event_store. An application serving a Nexus operation from a DBAL journal needs both — and there are not two sources of truth, since event_store says which one it is.

buses.description: Ids of the Messenger buses the bundle installs its middleware on (resume lock, profiler). Empty, which is the default, installs them on every bus, and that is the historical behaviour. Naming buses avoids imposing a per-execution lock on the business command bus, which carries no durable message.

cache.description: PSR-6 cache pool ID for activity contract metadata

contracts.description: Class names of activity contracts to warm at cache warmup

http_method_override.description: Set true to enable support for the '_method' request parameter to determine the intended HTTP method on POST requests.

allowed_http_method_override.description: Sets the list of HTTP methods that can be overridden. Set to null to allow all methods to be overridden (default). Set to an empty array to disallow overrides entirely. Otherwise, provide the list of uppercased method names that are allowed.

trust_x_sendfile_type_header.description: Set true to enable support for xsendfile in binary file responses.

ide.description: Deprecated since symfony/framework-bundle 8.2: Setting the "framework.ide.ide" configuration option is deprecated, use the "SYMFONY_IDE" env var instead.

set_locale_from_accept_language.description: Whether to use the Accept-Language HTTP header to set the Request locale (only when the "_locale" request attribute is not passed).

set_content_language_from_locale.description: Whether to set the Content-Language HTTP header on the Response using the Request locale.

enabled_locales.description: Defines the possible locales for the application. This list is used for generating translations files, but also to restrict which locales are allowed when it is set from Accept-Language header (using "set_locale_from_accept_language").

handle_all_throwables.description: HttpKernel will handle all kinds of \Throwable.

stateless_token_ids.description: Enable headers/cookies-based CSRF validation for the listed token ids.

check_header.description: Whether to check the CSRF token in a header in addition to a cookie when using stateless protection.

cookie_name.description: The name of the cookie to use when using stateless protection.

cache_status.description: Enables the RFC 9211 "Cache-Status" response header and names this cache in it, e.g. "Symfony". No header is added when null.

terminate_on_cache_hit.description: Deprecated since symfony/framework-bundle 8.1: Setting the "framework.http_cache.terminate_on_cache_hit.terminate_on_cache_hit" configuration option is deprecated. It will be removed in version 9.0.

hinclude_default_template.description: Deprecated since symfony/framework-bundle 8.2: Setting the "framework.fragments.hinclude_default_template.hinclude_default_template" configuration option is deprecated. It will be removed in version 9.0.

expiration.description: Default expiration of signed URIs, in seconds.

collect_parameter.description: The name of the parameter to use to enable or disable collection on a per request basis.

excluded_paths.description: Regular expressions matched against the url-decoded path info of the requests that must not be profiled. Patterns are case-sensitive and must not contain delimiters.

items.description: Regular expressions matched against the url-decoded path info that restrict the exclusion of this status code. When empty, every response having that status code is excluded.

excluded_http_codes.description: Maps HTTP status codes whose responses must not be profiled to regular expressions restricting each exclusion to matching path infos.

collect_serializer_data.description: Deprecated since symfony/framework-bundle 8.1: Setting the "framework.profiler.collect_serializer_data.collect_serializer_data" configuration option is deprecated. It will be removed in version 9.0.

handler_id.description: Defaults to using the native session handler, or to the native *file* session handler if "save_path" is not null.

save_path.description: Defaults to "%kernel.cache_dir%/sessions" if the "handler_id" option is not null.

metadata_update_threshold.description: Seconds to wait between 2 session metadata updates.

log.description: Use the application logger instead of the PHP logger for logging PHP errors.
examples: "true" to use the default configuration: log all errors. "false" to disable. An integer bit field of E_* constants, or an array mapping E_* constants to log levels.

throw.description: Throw PHP errors as \ErrorException instances. Enabled by default when debug is enabled.

log_level.description: The level of log message. Null to let Symfony decide.

status_code.description: The status code of the response. Null or 0 to let Symfony decide.

log_channel.description: The channel of log message. Null to let Symfony decide.

disallow_search_engine_index.description: Enabled by default when debug is enabled.

max_host_connections.description: The maximum number of connections to a single host.

vars.description: Associative array: the default vars used to expand the templated URI.

max_redirects.description: The maximum number of redirects to follow.

http_version.description: The default HTTP version, typically 1.1 or 2.0, leave to null for the best version.

proxy.description: The URL of the proxy to pass requests through or null for automatic detection.

no_proxy.description: A comma separated list of hosts that do not require a proxy to be reached.

timeout.description: The idle timeout, defaults to the "default_socket_timeout" ini parameter.

max_duration.description: The maximum execution time for the request+response as a whole.

max_connect_duration.description: The maximum duration allowed for DNS + TCP + TLS connection; a value lower than or equal to 0 means unlimited.

bindto.description: A network interface name, IP address, a host name or a UNIX socket to bind to.

verify_peer.description: Indicates if the peer should be verified in a TLS context.

verify_host.description: Indicates if the host should exist as a certificate common name.

capath.description: A directory that contains multiple certificate authority files.

passphrase.description: The passphrase used to encrypt the "local_pk" file.

ciphers.description: A list of TLS ciphers separated by colons, commas or spaces (e.g. "RC3-SHA:TLS13-AES-128-GCM-SHA256"...).

crypto_method.description: The minimum version of TLS to accept; must be one of STREAM_CRYPTO_METHOD_TLSv*_CLIENT constants.

extra.description: Extra options for specific HTTP client.

rate_limiter.description: Rate limiter name to use for throttling requests.

cache_pool.description: The taggable cache pool to use for storing the responses.

shared.description: Indicates whether the cache is shared (public) or private.

max_ttl.description: The maximum TTL (in seconds) allowed for cached responses.

base_uris.description: Additional URIs to retry against, tried in turn after the base URI, one per attempt.

retry_strategy.description: service id to override the retry strategy.

methods.description: A list of HTTP methods that triggers a retry for this status code. When empty, all methods are retried.

http_codes.description: A list of HTTP status code that triggers a retry.

delay.description: Time in ms to delay (or the initial value when multiplier is used).

multiplier.description: If greater than 1, delay will grow exponentially for each retry: delay * (multiple ^ retries).

max_delay.description: Max time in ms that a retry should ever be delayed (0 = infinite).

jitter.description: Randomness in percent (between 0 and 1) to apply to the delay.

mock_response_factory.description: `true` to always return empty 200 responses, or the id of the service to use to generate mock responses - which should be either an invokable or an iterable.

scope.description: The regular expression that the request URL must match before adding the other options. When none is provided, the base URI is used instead.

base_uri.description: The URI to resolve relative URLs, following rules in RFC 3985, section 2.

auth_bearer.description: A token enabling HTTP Bearer authorization.

auth_ntlm.description: A "username:password" pair to use Microsoft NTLM authentication (requires the cURL extension).

query.description: Associative array of query string values merged with the base URI.

mock_response_factory.description: `true` to always return empty 200 responses, `false` to disable mocking, or the id of the service to use to generate mock responses (invokable or iterable).

max_redirects.description: The maximum number of redirects to follow.

http_version.description: The default HTTP version, typically 1.1 or 2.0, leave to null for the best version.

verify_host.description: Indicates if the host should exist as a certificate common name.

crypto_method.description: The minimum version of TLS to accept; must be one of STREAM_CRYPTO_METHOD_TLSv*_CLIENT constants.

retry_strategy.description: service id to override the retry strategy.

methods.description: A list of HTTP methods that triggers a retry for this status code. When empty, all methods are retried.

http_codes.description: A list of HTTP status code that triggers a retry.

max_delay.description: Max time in ms that a retry should ever be delayed (0 = infinite).

additionalProperties.description: Each store is a DSN, a store keyword, the id of a service holding a connection, or an array with a "service_id" key and an "advisory" key.

resources.description: Defaults to a "default" resource using the semaphore store when it is supported, the flock store otherwise.

default_serializer.description: Service id to use as the default serializer for the transports.

format.description: Serialization format for the messenger.transport.symfony_serializer service (which is not the serializer used by default).

context.description: Context array for the messenger.transport.symfony_serializer service (which is not the serializer used by default).

serializer.description: Service id of a custom serializer to use.

cache_pool.description: Service id of the dedicated cache pool used to store claims. Pools declared under "framework.cache.pools" must define a "default_lifetime".

max_size.description: Maximum encoded message size in bytes before using a claim check.

failure_transport.description: Transport name to send failed messages to (after all retries have failed).

outbox.description: Name of the transport that stores the messages inside the current database transaction; consume that transport to forward them to this one.

service.description: Service id to override the retry strategy entirely.

delay.description: Time in ms to delay (or the initial value when multiplier is used).

multiplier.description: If greater than 1, delay will grow exponentially for each retry: this delay = (delay * (multiple ^ retries)).

max_delay.description: Max time in ms that a retry should ever be delayed (0 = infinite).

jitter.description: Randomness to apply to the delay (between 0 and 1).

rate_limiter.description: Rate limiter name to use when processing messages.

priority.description: Order in which "messenger:consume --all" consumes this transport, higher comes first.

failure_transport.description: Transport name to send failed messages to (after all retries have failed).

stop_worker_on_signals.description: A list of signals that should stop the worker; defaults to SIGTERM and SIGINT.

reject_redelivered_messages.description: Whether redeliveries should be rejected and retried through a new message instead of being handled directly. This mostly makes sense for AMQP, which redelivers messages that were neither acknowledged nor rejected. Disabling it avoids losing a message when the retry or the failure transport is unreachable, at the risk of a redelivery loop that blocks the queue.

wildcard_reads.description: Enables reading every element of a collection through a "[*]" wildcard.

default_uri.description: The default URI used to generate URLs in a non-HTTP context.

strict_requirements.description:
set to true to throw an exception when a parameter does not match the requirements
set to false to disable exceptions when a parameter does not match the requirements (and return null instead)
set to null to disable parameter checks against requirements
'true' is the preferred configuration in development mode, while 'false' or 'null' might be preferred in production

include_built_in_normalizers.description: Whether to include the built-in normalizers

include_built_in_encoders.description: Whether to include the built-in encoders

aliases.description: Additional type aliases to be used during type context creation.

uuid47_secret.description: A high-entropy secret used by the "uuid47_transformer" service. Defaults to the "kernel.secret" parameter; the service is not registered when neither is defined.
